title: solidago nemoralis subsp. longipetiolata
intro: Solidago nemoralis subsp. longipetiolata, commonly known as Long-petioled White Goldenrod, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting the immune system. Bioactive constituents of Solidago nemoralis subsp. longipetiolata include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
